description.zh: 点击触发元素后在其旁边弹出的非模态浮层，可承载文字说明、小型表单、日期选择等中等复杂内容。 无遮罩、不阻断页面其余部分，点击外部区域或 Esc 即关闭。
description.en: A non-modal layer that pops up beside its trigger on click, carrying medium-complex content such as text, a mini-form or a date picker. No backdrop and no blocking of the rest of the page; clicking outside or pressing Esc closes it.

use_when.zh: 点击后需要承载可交互内容（小表单、过滤、颜色选择）
use_when.en: Interactive content on click (mini-form, filters, color picker)

use_when.zh: 补充说明的信息量超过一行 tooltip
use_when.en: Explanations longer than a one-line tooltip

use_when.zh: 需要保持底层页面可见且可用
use_when.en: The page must stay visible and usable

avoid_when.zh: 只有一句话说明（改用 tooltip）
avoid_when.en: A one-line hint — use a tooltip

avoid_when.zh: 强制确认或长流程（改用 modal）
avoid_when.en: Forced confirmation or long flows — use a modal

avoid_when.zh: 内容需要大量滚动（改用 drawer）

disambiguation.zh: Popover 是锚定触发元素的非打断浮层，内容任意；Tooltip 只读、悬停即出；Dropdown 列表只放命令。
disambiguation.en: A popover is a non-blocking anchored overlay with free-form content. A tooltip is read-only on hover. A dropdown list holds commands only.

note.zh: Tooltip 只读、短暂、悬停触发；Popover 可交互、点击触发。
note.en: A tooltip is brief read-only on hover; a popover is interactive on click.

note.zh: Dropdown 列表是命令项，Popover 内容任意。
note.en: A dropdown list is commands; popover content is free-form.

note.zh: Modal 遮罩整页，Popover 不遮罩、可点外部关闭。
note.en: A modal dims the page; a popover does not, and dismisses on outside click.

note.zh: 内含输入框、按钮等可操作元素
带图片或结构化信息卡

打断程度.en: Low — no backdrop, page stays live

移动端友好.zh: 差，锚定位置易溢出屏幕

notes.zh: 以触发元素为锚 absolute 定位（或用 floating-ui 思路测量并翻转防溢出）。 点击外部关闭：在 document 上监听 pointerdown 判断 target 是否在浮层内；Esc 同样关闭，焦点移入浮层。 入场 scale 0.95→1 加淡入，150~200ms；尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
notes.en: Anchor to the trigger with absolute positioning (or measure and flip like floating-ui to prevent overflow). Close on outside click: listen for pointerdown on document and check the target; Esc closes too and focus moves into the panel. Enter with scale 0.95→1 plus fade, 150–200ms; respect prefers-reduced-motion.

basic.zh: 创建一个气泡卡片（Popover）组件：点击按钮在按钮旁弹出小卡片，点击外部区域关闭。
basic.en: Create a Popover component: clicking a button opens a small card next to it, clicking outside closes it.

design.zh: 创建 Popover 组件。要求：浮层卡片出现在触发元素下方（带小箭头），圆角、边框、大阴影； 标题 + 正文 + 可选操作区；入场轻微放大淡入；点击外部与 Esc 关闭；深浅色主题一致。
design.en: Create a Popover. Requirements: the card appears below the trigger (with a small arrow), rounded, bordered, heavily shadowed; title, body and optional action row; subtle zoom-and-fade entrance; closes on outside click and Esc; consistent light/dark themes.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现 Popover：触发元素 relative 包裹，浮层 absolute top-full； open 受控，useEffect 在 document 监听 pointerdown，target 不在容器内则关闭， 监听 keydown Esc 关闭；入场 keyframes（scale + opacity，时长乘 var(--demo-speed, 1)）； 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind Popover: relative wrapper around the trigger, absolute top-full panel; controlled open state; useEffect listens for pointerdown on document and closes when the target is outside, plus Esc on keydown; enter keyframes (scale + opacity) scaled by var(--demo-speed, 1); respect prefers-reduced-motion.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现气泡卡片（Popover）组件。

先检查现有组件体系与 Design Token，优先复用现有的表面色、圆角与阴影变量。
用途：帮助说明与小型操作面板。
要求：
- 锚定触发元素，贴近屏幕边缘时自动翻转
- 点击外部与 Esc 关闭，焦点管理正确
- 入场动画轻微，尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 不新增依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Implement a Popover component in the current project.

Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse existing
surface, radius and shadow variables.
Usage: help explanations and small action panels.
Requirements:
- Anchored to the trigger, flips near screen edges
- Closes on outside click and Esc, with correct focus management
- Subtle enter animation, respecting prefers-reduced-motion
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

task.zh: 点击触发入口打开浮层，检查内容与关闭方式。
task.en: Open the popover and inspect its content and dismissal.

checks.zh: 浮层应靠近触发位置，避免遮住关键操作。
checks.en: Position it near its trigger without obscuring essential actions.

checks.zh: 若内容可交互，必须支持键盘访问。
checks.en: Interactive content must remain keyboard accessible.
